title: 06-17-2025 South Jordan City Council Study Meeting Minutes - FINAL

votes.motion: Council Member Harris motioned to amend the City Council Study Meeting agenda to move Item D. Discussion/Review of Regular Council Meeting after Item F. Discussion Items

Council Member McGuire motioned to amend the City Council Study Meeting agenda to switch the order of agenda items F.1. and F.2., so the discussion on the Altitude development project would be held first, followed by the parks master plan and impact fee discussion
Council Member McGuire motioned to adjourn the June 17, 2025 City Council Study Meeting
